# ADR-3231: AWS logging: Config recorder required key for region 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Without Config, drift and noncompliance hide.

## Decision

Regions MUST enable a Config recorder required key for region 7 (AWS-logging-7).

## Consequences

Rules evaluate continuous compliance.
